theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_pfc_pullback_integrand_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U K O : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (R.carrier \ K) = 0 → IsOpen O → K ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O → ∃ A : ℝ, 0 ≤ A ∧ ∀ (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (B : ℝ), Continuous ω → (∀ z, ‖ω z‖ ≤ B) → Integrable (fun x => (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x ((ω (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x))) (μHE[n].restrict R.carrier) ∧ |∫ x in R.carrier, (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x ((ω (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) ∂μHE[n]| ≤ A * B
